summary.description: Two or three sentences: what the commit changes and whether it is safe to merge.

findings.description: Vulnerabilities the commit introduces or newly exposes, most severe first. Empty when there are none.

cwe.description: The closest CWE id, such as CWE-89.

file.description: The file's path as the diff names it.

line.description: The line in the new version of the file.

explanation.description: What is wrong, how it could be exploited in this code, and the evidence in the diff.

patch.description: A unified diff against the new version that fixes the most severe finding and changes nothing else; null when there is no confident fix.
